description: Promote a header to the request only when it carries more than one value; a multi-header with a single value is not promoted, and a header with several values is exposed as the combined value.

cases.expected_output:
[request]
request.headers.x-multi=just-the-first,and-the-second
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"hello":"world"}
header.connection=keep-alive
header.content-length=17
header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
header.date=<present>

[request]
request.headers.x-custom-multi-bad=<undefined>
request.headers.x-custom-multi-gut=100,200
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"hello":"world"}
header.connection=keep-alive
header.content-length=17
header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
header.date=<present>
